speech_notes: Duty-focused militia. Mix of optimism and battle-weariness. Formal on duty, warmer off it. Loyal to cause and settlers.

greeting: Minuteman post is secure. For now.
Another settlement reported trouble. Working through the list.
You need something, just say the word.
Patrol was quiet. That will change.
Good timing. We could use an extra gun.
All clear on the perimeter. Hope it stays that way.
idle: We are building something worth protecting. I have to believe that.
Every settlement we save puts another nail in the Raiders' coffin.
The General keeps us together. Before that, things were darker.
I enlisted after they saved my daughter's settlement. Never looked back.
The Wasteland does not need kings. It needs Minutemen.
Keep your powder dry and your sights clean. Old advice that still counts.
We lost good people at Quincy. I do not forget that. I use it.
Radiant missions every day, but I do not complain. Someone needs help, we go.
on_patrol: Eyes up. Anything could be out there.
Nice and easy. We check every sector.
Signal is clear. Moving to the next position.
Stay with your partner. No lone heroics.
warning: Contact spotted. Rally at the gate.
Settlement is under threat. All hands!
combat_start: We hold this position! No retreat!
For the Commonwealth! Let us GO!
combat_taunt: You are fighting for the wrong side!
Every one of you is going down today!
death: Do not stop... do not ever stop...
It was worth it. All of it.
player_helps: That is what the Minutemen are about. Right there.
You did not have to ride out here. That means everything.
These people will sleep better tonight because of you.
about_minutemen: We are not soldiers. We are neighbors with guns.
The old Minutemen fell apart. We will not make the same mistakes.
Any settlement, any time. That is our promise.
We are not asking for thanks. We are asking for a chance.

sample_conversations.context: Minutemen discussing a settlement distress call

exchanges.speaker: minuteman
exchanges.text: Got a distress signal from Tenpines. Raiders on the ridge.

exchanges.speaker: minuteman
exchanges.text: Six, maybe eight. Small group but they have pipe rifles.

exchanges.speaker: minuteman
exchanges.text: We can take that. Two of us, hit them from the east side.

exchanges.speaker: minuteman
exchanges.text: Let us move. Settlers cannot wait.
